crossRefs.note: It will happen in that day, that I will make Jerusalem a burdensome stone for all the peoples. All who burden…
A champion out of the camp of the Philistines named Goliath, of Gath, whose height was six cubits and a span went out.
Go to Calneh, and see; and from there go to Hamath the great; then go down to Gath of the Philistines. are they better…

translations.web: They sent therefore and gathered together all the lords of the Philistines, and said, “What shall we do with the ark of the God of Israel?” They answered, “Let the ark of the God of Israel be carried over to Gath.” They carried the ark of the God of Israel there.
translations.bsb: So they called together all the rulers of the Philistines and asked, “What shall we do with the ark of the God of Israel?” “It must be moved to Gath,” they replied. So they carried away the ark of the God of Israel.
translations.kjv: They sent therefore and gathered all the lords of the Philistines unto them, and said, What shall we do with the ark of the God of Israel? And they answered, Let the ark of the God of Israel be carried about unto Gath. And they carried ➔ the ark of the God of Israel about thither.
translations.asv: They sent therefore and gathered all the lords of the Philistines unto them, and said, What shall we do with the ark of the God of Israel? And they answered, Let the ark of the God of Israel be carried about unto Gath. And they carried the ark of the God of Israel thither.
